messages:
Nora (CS): Vanguard Systems (acct VGD-900) just sent a VAT-exemption certificate for their EU entity and says the March/April invoices were charged VAT. They attached the certificate and asked for a tax-only refund + corrected invoice for procurement. INV-2026-03-9001 and INV-2026-04-9002.

billing-bot: INV-2026-03-9001 generated 2026-03-02 09:10 UTC: Subtotal $9,200.00; VAT 20% $1,840.00; Total $11,040.00. INV-2026-04-9002 generated 2026-04-02 09:12 UTC: Subtotal $9,600.00; VAT 20% $1,920.00; Total $11,520.00.

Diego (BillingOps): Checking ledger and tax tags. Customer billing address = Ireland. VAT charge applied because record lacked exemption flag. I can reverse tax lines and issue two tax-credit memos, but need Legal on certificate validity and Finance sign-off for refunds >$1k.

Priya (Finance): Quick calc: March VAT = 1,840.00, April VAT = 1,920.00. Total tax refund = 3,760.00. This is >$1.5k so manager-level approval required. Nora, confirm customer provided a valid VAT-MOSS exemption or local VAT-ID and effective date covering invoiced periods.

Nora (CS): They provided VAT ID IE3456789 and a signed exemption letter dated 2026-04-05 saying the EU entity is VAT-registered and exempt for software services. They ask we treat it retroactively to 2026-03-01. They've provided company registration docs and a contact at procurement.

Ellen (Legal): I'll validate docs. If the VAT ID is valid and covers the period, we're ok to issue tax-only credits. We should not mark these as goodwill — it's a tax reclassification. Also add a short legal note on the customer statement referencing certificate ID EX-2026-04-77. Give me 1 business day to confirm.

Diego (BillingOps): While Legal confirms, I ran a draft credit compute:
March VAT reversal: 1,840.00
April VAT reversal: 1,920.00
Total refundable tax: 3,760.00
Suggested memos: TAX-CR-2026-04-9001 and TAX-CR-2026-04-9002 (applied to respective invoices). I can create provisional credit memos pending Legal/Finance approvals.

Priya (Finance): Manager approves tax refunds pending Legal confirmation. For customer goodwill (they requested expedited handling), I can approve up to $200 in discretionary credit to help procurement close the P.O. If you want the $200, Nora get explicit customer acceptance for a goodwill credit.

Nora (CS): I'll offer the $200 goodwill as a one-time procurement courtesy; they'll accept if we include corrected invoices. Proceeding to gather acceptance.

Ellen (Legal): VAT ID validation complete: IE3456789 matches government registry and coverage includes March/April 2026. Legal approves tax credits. Note: add statement line "Tax adjustment per customer-supplied VAT registration EX-2026-04-77."

Diego (BillingOps): Creating tax credit memos now. Entries:
TAX-CR-2026-04-9001 -> -1840.00 applied to INV-2026-03-9001
TAX-CR-2026-04-9002 -> -1920.00 applied to INV-2026-04-9002
If customer accepts goodwill, create memo CR-2026-04-9010 -> -200.00 separate and mark "customer-approved". Posts scheduled for 2026-04-06 14:00 UTC.

billing-bot: TAX-CR-2026-04-9001 and TAX-CR-2026-04-9002 created and applied. New balances: INV-2026-03-9001 $9,200.00; INV-2026-04-9002 $9,600.00.

Nora (CS): Customer confirmed acceptance of $200 procurement courtesy. Please apply CR-2026-04-9010.

Diego (BillingOps): Applied CR-2026-04-9010 (-200.00) to INV-2026-04-9002. Ledger notes added: TAX-ADJ EX-2026-04-77; Goodwill procurement courtesy approved by Priya (Finance).

Priya (Finance): Thanks. Leave a short memo for auditors: "Tax credits issued per validated VAT registration EX-2026-04-77; total tax refund 3,760.00; goodwill 200.00." Thread closed.
